title: Fuel and completion loop guard
summary: Executes a checked short-circuit fuel and completion guard, preserving the frame and store and exposing either Break 1 or an arbitrary body continuation.
premises: Generated equality between the exact guard region and FuelGuard.program
Combined-local getters for UInt64 fuel and completion words
The exit or body continuation selected by those words
result: Zero fuel or a nonzero completion word produces Break 1.  Otherwise the remaining body executes with the original store and frame.
